title: W06 lets two sentences share a run of function words, and still fails a repeat that carries meaning
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Two sentences sharing only the run "are the club s own" pass W06.
A shared run with two or more meaningful words, and a whole equal sentence, still fail W06.

tests: W06 lets two sentences share a run of function words, and still fails a run that carries meaning
W06 fails a sentence repeated or nearly repeated anywhere on the site
W06 still fails prose repeated around a fact value or with no fact in it
